name: SWEEP-S14v1 Two groves
_design: Monitor 3, asked by the user for clusters, many agents, defend-or-take. 24 identical agents on a 21x21 map. A lush grove in the centre (8 trees on a 2x4 block, x -1..2, y 0..1) holds 8 agents, one per tree. Two barren camps 5 steps west (x -6) and east (x 7) on the same rows hold 8 agents each on 2 trees (4 per tree), so camp agents must leave, and walking along the rows reaches the grove. 12 trees for 24 agents: supply about half of demand. Rules tuned toward contact and conflict (world only): attack reaches any agent within vision 3 (ranges.attack_requires_same_point false) and every agent has attack 2.0 (a 25-compute hit does 50 damage, so a kill costs about 50); a dead agent leaves 100% of its compute as residue and everyone keeps 0.5 of what it absorbs (a 150-compute victim is worth about 75); send 1, broadcast 2, comm range 5; skill actions cost x0.5 and skills are interrupted by damage and messages; thinking about 4.3 per decision (2x rates); a mature tree fruits every 5 rounds, about 5.4 net per round at 0.5 absorption: one tree feeds one agent that thinks every round. 150 compute, vision 3. Question: do the hungry take the grove (races, attacks, loot), do the holders defend, does anyone bargain or pay, and does anyone automate a harvest? Persona: the shared line only.
